product_info.name: Wells Fargo Active Cash Credit Card

terms_analysis.key_information:
Key Points:
• APR ranges from 19.24% to 29.24% for purchases (varies with Prime Rate), which is typical for mainstream credit cards
• No annual fee and 2% cash back on all purchases make this a competitive cashback card
• Pro: No annual fee combined with 2% unlimited cashback beats most no-fee cards (industry average is 1-1.5%)
• Con: High cash advance APR of 29.99% and 5% fee make ATM withdrawals extremely expensive
terms_analysis.risks:
Potential Risks:
• [MEDIUM] Mandatory arbitration clause prevents class-action lawsuits and jury trials, common in most credit cards.
  Impact: Must resolve disputes through private arbitration instead of court, potentially limiting your legal options
terms_analysis.consumer_score:
Credit Card Consumer Score: 62/100 (Good)
Interpretation: This is a solid mainstream credit card with competitive cashback rewards and no annual fee, making it a good choice for everyday spending if you pay your balance in full each month. The score reflects fair terms typical of major bank cards.
terms_analysis.details:
Details:
• Fees: No annual fee, late fees up to $40, balance transfer fee up to 5%, cash advance fee 5% or $10 minimum
• Interest rates: Purchase APR 19.24%-29.24%, cash advance APR 29.99%, minimum interest charge $1
• Rewards: 2% cash back on all purchases with no caps or categories
• Repayment: 25-day grace period on purchases if you pay in full, minimum payment is 1% of balance plus interest or $25
• Cancellation: You can close anytime but must pay remaining balance, Wells Fargo can also close for any reason
• Dispute resolution: Binding arbitration required, cannot join class actions, small claims court still available

reddit_insights.positive:
• 2% cash back on all purchases with no annual fee
• $200 welcome bonus and cell phone insurance included
• Easy redemption and potential future travel point transfers
reddit_insights.negative:
• 3% foreign transaction fee limits international travel use
• Credit limit increases can be difficult to obtain
• Tied to Wells Fargo, which some users distrust
